      INTERVENOR GRETCHEN NOELKE’S REQUESTED CORRECTION TO SOAH
                       ORDER 30 AND EXHIBIT LIST

TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES: ​
​
Intervenor Gretchen Noelke participated in the pre-trial conference on June 5, 2026 through her agent,
George Noelke. Based on the instructions provided by the Honorable ALJ’s at that proceeding she
respectfully requests the corrections below related to SOAH Order No. 30 (Item 5835) and her timely
filed Exhibit List and Designation of Witnesses (Item 5485).

I. EXHIBITS

Gretchen Noelke submits the following corrected exhibit list:



    Exhibit No.                                      Description

    Gretchen Noelke Exhibit 1                        Gretchen Noelke’s Direct Testimony Opposing
                                                     Links M7 and M22 (Item 3997)

    Gretchen Noelke Exhibit 2                        Applicants’ Response to Gretchen Noelke’s First
                                                     Request for Information (Item 5443)




                                                                                                         1
 This correction is necessary because this Court advised all parties at the prehearing conference that
statements of position should not be included as an exhibit. Her previous Exhibit No. 1 was her statement
of position. Her revised Exhibit No. 1 is now her direct testimony. Applicants’ response to her First
Request for Information (Item 5443) is now corrected to Exhibit 2. This document was filed by the
Applicants on the Interchange on June 2, 2026, and uploaded by George Noelke to Kiteworks on June 5,
2026 before the start of the prehearing conference and to Egnyte during that proceeding. If this is
considered a late filing, Gretchen Noelke notes that Applicants stated no objection at the prehearing
conference, and, in any event, this Court reserved taking objections on the admission of exhibits until the
commencement of the hearing on the merits on June 8, 2026. Therefore, there is no harm to Applicants.

Judge Brite observed that Gretchen Noelke’s name would be included in Attachment A at the prehearing
conference. Gretchen Noelke thus respectfully requests that her name be included on the Attachment A
of SOAH Order No. 30, and she moves for the admission of Gretchen Noelke Exhibits 1 and 2. She
anticipates no objection from Applicants because these documents qualify as direct testimony and
responses to discovery, which this Court identified as acceptable in its Order No. 30, page 2.

II. IDENTIFICATION OF WITNESSES

Gretchen Noelke makes no corrections to her earlier filed identification of witnesses. She does not intend
to call any witnesses to testify during the hearing on the merits. Further, she does not identify any witness
for cross-examination during that hearing.

III. ATTACHMENT B, ORDER OF CROSS EXAMINATION, ORDER NO. 30

Gretchen Noelke is identified in Attachment B of Order No. 30 as No. 628. However, she has not listed
any party to cross, and no party has listed her to cross. She reserves further argument to post hearing
briefing and exceptions to this Court’s Proposal for Decision since this Court instructed at the prehearing
conference that it would not permit reservations to call witnesses at the hearing on the merits due to time
constraints.

Signed June 6, 2026

Respectfully submitted,​
/s/ Gretchen Noelke by George Noelke, Agent​
Gretchen Noelke by George Noelke, Agent​
Intervenor​
Pro se Landowner
